title: BIODANCE Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask for Hydrating & Plumping (4ea)
description: PORE TIGHTENING & FIRMING: Formulated with ultra-low molecular collagen to help refine the appearance of enlarged pores, maintain skin elasticity, and smooth the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles DEEP HYDRATION: Oligo-hyaluronic acid in the Biodance Bio-Collagen Real Deep Mask provides superior moisturizing effects compared to regular hyaluronic acid. It quickly hydrates the skin's surface and penetrates deeper layers, leaving the complexion feeling soft, smooth, and well-moisturized BRIGHTENS THE SKIN: Formulated with Galactomyces Ferment Filtrate and Niacinamide to help maintain an even-looking skin tone and texture while providing antioxidant benefits for healthier-looking, more radiant skin UNIQUE OVERNIGHT ABSORPTION: Each 1.19 oz bottle of essence is solidified into each mask sheet. Unlike regular sheet masks, our signature hydrogel mask becomes transparent as active ingredients melt deep into the skin. Recommended for overnight use or a minimum of 3-4 hours for a flawless glass-skin glow SAFE FOR SENSITIVE SKIN: Formulated without 19 specified ingredients of concern to provide gentle care for sensitive skin. We ensure safe, hypoallergenic care that delivers deep, long-lasting improvements beyond temporary effects. CONVENIENT TRAVEL SIZE: Includes four individually packaged 1.19 oz hydrogel masks, making them easy to pack for travel or enjoy as self-care essentials at home as part of your Korean skincare routine
